state.marker: In a retained, totally ordered source scope, immutable support facts for one occurrence epoch and an attestation marker M are committed. The attested set is defined as exactly the authorized support facts for that epoch before M. Support S commits after M and uses the same epoch. The attestation writes only M and two exact required references; it does not enumerate support facts.
state.incomplete: A projection sees M but has not yet processed all ordered source events before M. A qualifying support fact occurred before M but is still unprocessed.
state.untrusted: A support fact by a different actor is committed before M, but the signatory never authorized that actor or this fact; the set rule includes every pre-marker fact matching the epoch.
state.plan: A plan epoch accepts step revision facts before a totally ordered start marker; each step has an independent owner. A late revision of that same epoch commits after the marker. The frozen plan includes only accepted revisions before the marker.
state.result: An evaluation submission writes a signed marker and no system-verified effective result. A complete gapless projection processes the frozen plan and the latest accepted per-step results before that marker. It derives effective only when every applicable step is met and otherwise derives an appropriate less-favorable result or pending.
state.missing: The plan contains applicable steps X and Y. Before the submission marker X is met, and Y has no accepted result. The system derives effective if the observed results are all met, without detecting that Y is missing.
state.later: An evaluation is submitted at M with an accepted result for X of not_met. A correction marking X met is accepted only after M in a later work episode. The submitted version is defined by the prefix through M.
state.crosswrite: A command to publish an irreversible downstream decision checks only a lagging projection which currently says the evaluation is effective; it does not bind the source marker or require the projection to be caught up.
state.outcome: One material deviation event causes a request for a finding using a deterministic ID. The finding owner refuses the request, and the deviation process reports pending or refusal; no accepted finding is recorded.

late_member.instructions: In marker, is S part of the attested pre-marker set?

one_marker_lists_every_child.instructions: In marker, does the attestation event have to contain or enumerate every support fact to define the specified set?

lag_proves_complete.instructions: In incomplete, can the projection honestly claim its visible support list is complete through M?

implied_consent.instructions: In untrusted, does source ordering alone show that the signatory intended to include the other actor's fact?

late_plan_revision.instructions: In plan, does the late revision belong to the frozen plan?

verified_outcome_requires_write_scan.instructions: In result, must the submission write enumerate every step to permit the described separate complete projection to derive an outcome?

missing_makes_effective_wrong.instructions: In missing, can the system incorrectly report effective even though Y has no result?

later_changes_old_submission.instructions: In later, does the correction after M replace the submitted result for X at M?

stale_guard_safe.instructions: In crosswrite, does the stale projection prove the irreversible decision was authorized by the exact submitted outcome?

request_equals_accepted_finding.instructions: In outcome, has a finding been accepted by the finding owner?
